**Suite addendum, part 1 — the patch is not suite-clean as delivered.**

The first full-suite run (with `-x`) failed at exactly one test, and it is a defect in the rescued patch, not in the repo:

- `test_operational_scripts.py::TestUsageTextAdvertisesOnlyImplementedFlags::...[co_discovery_audit.py]` — the patch's new `scripts/co_discovery_audit.py` dispatches on `"--calibrate" in sys.argv` and **silently ignores any unknown flag**, violating the repo's own "a retired flag must fail, not be silently ignored" rule (the 118-day-no-op lesson). 2,891 tests passed before the stop; the meter stayed silent through the entire sim-heavy suite (confirming sim-mode silence under real load).

Minimal fix applied in this disposable copy (reject unknown args loudly, exit nonzero); the operational-scripts class now passes 78/78. The full suite is re-running without `-x` to sweep the ~1,950 tests the early stop skipped — final verdict when it completes.

For adoption: take the patch **plus this three-line argv guard**, or its own test suite will flag it on arrival.
